summary: Expose canonical block economics verified against execution commitments
details: Add eth_getUSDBBlockEconomics with an explicit canonical block hash. Replay transactions and existing reward finalization against retained parent state; return exact emission and fee accounting only when state root, receipt root, bloom and gas usage match the block.

Bind Miner Pass references and economic policies to the target block, preserve per-transaction fee rounding and fee-gate behavior, and measure emission credit separately from ordinary transfers and fee income. Genesis has no mined-reward report; unknown policy combinations fail closed.

Bound concurrent replays, block size, EVM execution time and successful-report cache; recheck canonical identity including cache hits. Missing history, incompatible policies, reorgs and verification failures have stable privacy-safe RPC errors.

The read-only method neither commits replay state nor changes consensus, chain identity or persistent storage. The issued counter includes genesis allocations and emission and is not a circulating-supply estimate.
operator_actions: Upgrade the Explorer read node to this runtime and retain parent archive state and the selector-pinned historical indexer data. Use the new Explorer block economics page for representative-block checks; enabling archive does not restore previously pruned state.
